ops.title: Release tags must be annotated AND GPG-signed with the trusted release key
ops.body:
Discovered while cutting v0.34.0 (2026-07-26). The reusable release workflow (`yasyf/homebrew-tap/.github/workflows/release-go.yml`) now runs a `verify-tag-on-main` action that rejects the tag two ways before goreleaser ever starts:

1. `remote ref is not an annotated tag object (type='commit'); lightweight tags are forbidden` — `git tag v0.34.0 origin/main` fails. The tag must be an annotated tag object (`git tag -s`/`-a`).
2. `GitHub did not verify the tag signature (reason='bad_email')` — the tag must be GPG-signed by the fingerprint the action pins as `TRUSTED_RELEASE_FINGERPRINT`, **and** GitHub must mark it verified, which requires the tagger email to match a UID on that key.

For this repo the pinned fingerprint is `F3299DE3FE0F6C3CF2B66BFBF7ECDD88A700D73A` (rsa4096, UID `Yasyf Mohamedali <yasyfm@gmail.com>`) — *not* the default `user.signingkey` (`4E7C358CCBEBA2D5`, ed25519, used for commits as `yasyf@poetic.com`). Signing with the default key and the default committer email produces `bad_email`.

The working incantation:

```
GIT_COMMITTER_NAME="Yasyf Mohamedali" GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL="yasyfm@gmail.com" \
  git tag -s -u F7ECDD88A700D73A -m "vX.Y.Z — <summary>" vX.Y.Z origin/main
git push origin vX.Y.Z
```

Confirm before waiting on the run:

```
TAGSHA=$(gh api repos/yasyf/cc-context/git/ref/tags/vX.Y.Z --jq .object.sha)
gh api repos/yasyf/cc-context/git/tags/$TAGSHA --jq '.verification'   # want verified=true reason=valid
```

Note this is newly enforced: v0.33.0 and v0.32.0 are both lightweight (`git cat-file -t v0.33.0` → `commit`) and released fine. `.claude/fragments/AGENTS.md/releases.fragment.md` still says to tag with a bare `git tag vX.Y.Z origin/main`, which is now wrong and cost two failed release runs — that fragment should be updated with the above.
